title: The Responsive W / Abstract chart
slide_intent: Show a family of valid variations together because range is easier to understand through comparison than a single logo specimen.
strategic_value: A chart of proportions can give Whitney’s designers a shared vocabulary for adapting the mark.
demonstration: A photographed folded sheet shows a matrix of uncolored W variants with Whitney held near the upper left.
practical_value: Compare the family’s narrow, wide, deep and asymmetric forms without treating the displayed set as an exhaustive menu.

content_islands.name: Variation field
content_islands.spec: Spread the progressively changing W specimens across the folded white sheet.

content_islands.name: Corner anchors
content_islands.spec: Retain the Whitney word on each applicable specimen and the small document identification.

reference_purposes.Intent: The essay calls the chart a handful of examples from an almost infinite set of possibilities.
reference_purposes.Expression: The sheet shows the recognizable W across a broad range of proportions.
reference_purposes.Application: The comparison chart provides variants designers can study for different available areas.
